## Objective
- Add English and Spanish support to the football career game while keeping it playable.

## Requirements
- Support `pt`, `en`, and `es`; keep Portuguese as the default and retain existing saves.
- Translate displayed UI text in English and Spanish while leaving Portuguese unchanged.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Portuguese remains the default to preserve existing behavior and saves.
- The document language maps to `pt-BR`, `en`, or `es`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added English and Spanish translation dictionaries and markup translation for text nodes and `aria-label`, `placeholder`, and `title` attributes.
- Preserved existing saves and settings while defaulting language to Portuguese and validating stored language values.
- Added language selectors to the settings page and settings modal; changes persist and refresh the UI.
- Applied translations during rendering, set the document language, translated toast messages, and localized displayed dates.
- Added translations for many new-career form labels, options, and helper text.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest translation dictionary edits.
- Headless Chromium checks confirmed the Portuguese default, English settings and new-career form, Spanish document language, and saved language setting.

### Active
- Review remaining untranslated text across screens and dynamic content.
- Verify language persistence after reload and playability through a match; rerun checks after final edits.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining untranslated English and Spanish UI, especially navigation, dynamic game content, and match results.
2. Test switching and persistence across reloads from both settings views.
3. Exercise a new career and match, then run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Translation dictionaries, language persistence and selection, rendering, settings, and game logic.
- `index.html`: App entry point and default document language metadata.

## Important Context
- `game.js` has uncommitted changes; the latest edits expanded the translation dictionaries and have not yet been followed by syntax/diff checks.
- `Agents.md` is also modified and should be treated as existing work.
- No screenshot was captured; visual verification used Chromium DOM output.

input.command: git status --short && git diff --stat && node --check game.js && git diff --check

## Objective
- Add English and Spanish support to the football career game while keeping it playable.

## Requirements
- Support `pt`, `en`, and `es`; keep Portuguese as the default and retain existing saves.
- Translate displayed UI text in English and Spanish while leaving Portuguese unchanged.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Portuguese remains the default to preserve existing behavior and saves.
- The document language maps to `pt-BR`, `en`, or `es`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added English and Spanish dictionaries, markup translation, language persistence and selection, document language updates, localized dates, and translations for many new-career form labels, options, and helper text.
- Added language selectors to the settings page and settings modal.
- Chromium checks previously confirmed Portuguese default, translated English and Spanish new-career content, document language changes, and persisted language settings.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed after the latest dictionary edits.

### Active
- Review untranslated text, particularly match results, dynamic game content, and navigation; recent inspection found many remaining English and Spanish dictionary gaps for game pages and match UI.
- Verify language persistence across reloads from both settings views, then exercise a new career and match.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for remaining navigation, page, modal, and dynamic game content, including match results.
2. Test language switching and persistence across reloads and play through a match.
3. Rerun `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`; capture a compliant screenshot if performing visual checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Translation dictionaries, language persistence and selection, rendering, settings, and game logic.
- `index.html`: App entry point and default document language metadata.

## Important Context
- `game.js` has uncommitted changes; `Agents.md` is also modified and should be treated as existing work.
- The dictionaries currently have 217 English and 214 Spanish entries, but game pages and match results still contain untranslated Portuguese content.
- No screenshot was captured; visual verification used Chromium DOM output.

## Objective
- Add English and Spanish support to the football career game while keeping it playable.

## Requirements
- Support `pt`, `en`, and `es`; keep Portuguese as the default and retain existing saves.
- Translate displayed UI text in English and Spanish while leaving Portuguese unchanged.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Portuguese remains the default to preserve existing behavior and saves.
- The document language maps to `pt-BR`, `en`, or `es`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added English and Spanish dictionaries, markup translation, language persistence and selection, document language updates, localized dates, and translations for many new-career form labels, options, and helper text.
- Added language selectors to the settings page and settings modal.
- Chromium checks previously confirmed Portuguese default, translated English and Spanish new-career content, document language changes, and persisted language settings.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed during the latest inspection.

### Active
- Expand translations for remaining navigation, page, modal, and dynamic game content, especially match results; inspection confirmed many UI strings remain untranslated.
- Verify language switching and persistence across reloads from both settings views, then exercise a new career and match.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add translations for remaining navigation, page, modal, and dynamic game content, including match results.
2. Test language switching and persistence across reloads, create a career, and play a match.
3. Rerun `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`; capture a compliant screenshot if performing visual checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Translation dictionaries, language persistence and selection, rendering, settings, and game logic.
- `index.html`: App entry point and default document language metadata.

## Important Context
- `game.js` and `Agents.md` have uncommitted changes.
- Translation dictionary objects are defined on lines 18–19; current dictionaries contain 217 English and 214 Spanish entries.
- Translation uses dictionary substitutions on rendered text nodes and selected attributes; dynamic strings need matching dictionary phrases.
- No screenshot was captured; visual verification used Chromium DOM output.

## Objective
- Add English and Spanish support to the football career game while keeping it playable.

## Requirements
- Support `pt`, `en`, and `es`; keep Portuguese as the default and retain existing saves.
- Translate displayed UI text in English and Spanish while leaving Portuguese unchanged.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Portuguese remains the default to preserve existing behavior and saves.
- The document language maps to `pt-BR`, `en`, or `es`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added English and Spanish dictionaries, markup translation, language persistence and selection, document language updates, localized dates, and translations for many game screens and dynamic content.
- Added language selectors to the settings page and settings modal.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Validate language switching and persistence from both settings views, career creation, and match play; check remaining untranslated dynamic text.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test `pt`, `en`, and `es` switching and persistence in both settings views, then create a career and play a match.
2. Review remaining untranslated strings, especially dynamic match results and game content.
3. If doing visual checks, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Translation dictionaries, language persistence and selection, UI rendering, settings, and game logic.
- `index.html`: App entry point and default document language metadata.

## Important Context
- `game.js` and `Agents.md` have uncommitted changes.
- The latest `node --check game.js && git diff --check` completed successfully.
- Chromium and `playwright-cli` are available, but no browser test or screenshot has been run in the current validation pass.

## Objective
- Add English and Spanish support to the football career game while keeping it playable.

## Requirements
- Support `pt`, `en`, and `es`; keep Portuguese as the default and retain existing saves.
- Translate displayed UI text in English and Spanish while leaving Portuguese unchanged.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Portuguese remains the default to preserve existing behavior and saves.
- The document language maps to `pt-BR`, `en`, or `es`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added English and Spanish dictionaries, markup translation, language persistence and selection, document language updates, localized dates, and translations for many game screens and dynamic content.
- Added language selectors to the settings page and settings modal.
- Validated language selection and persistence in settings, Spanish career continuation, and match simulation in a browser.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Fix remaining untranslated or wrongly translated dynamic text found during browser testing, then recheck Portuguese, English, and Spanish on career and match screens.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect dictionary entries and dynamic UI output for remaining untranslated Portuguese in English/Spanish; recent tests showed Portuguese menu labels and match/news text still present, and some Spanish strings still untranslated.
2. Fix dynamic/generated content translations, including match result/news and manager experience terms; verify dictionary changes take effect after reload.
3. Re-run language-switching, persistence, career creation, and match-play checks; run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Translation dictionaries, language persistence and selection, UI rendering, settings, and game logic.
- `index.html`: App entry point and default document language metadata.

## Important Context
- `game.js` and `Agents.md` have uncommitted changes.
- Local HTTP server is running on port `3002`; Playwright Chromium is installed.
- Browser checks revealed English menu labels such as `CONFIGURAÇÕES`, `ESTATÍSTICAS`, and `Jogo de gestão · Salvamento local automático` remained Portuguese; Spanish had similar untranslated labels.
- Spanish career and match screens still displayed Portuguese/dynamic phrases such as `VOCÊ`, `VER TABELA`, `apresenta`, `beginner`, and `GERENCIAR`; match modal itself was translated.

## Objective
- Complete English and Spanish support for the football career game while preserving Portuguese behavior and existing saves.
- Finish translating dynamic UI content and verify menu and career screens in all three languages.

## Requirements
- Support `pt`, `en`, and `es`; Portuguese remains the default.
- Translate displayed UI text in English and Spanish while leaving Portuguese unchanged.
- Preserve existing saves.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Portuguese remains the default to preserve existing behavior and saves.
- Document language maps to `pt-BR`, `en`, or `es`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added language dictionaries, markup translation, language persistence and selection, document language updates, localized dates, and language selectors in settings.
- Prior browser checks confirmed language selection and persistence, Spanish career continuation, and match simulation.
- Added English translations for several dashboard and dynamic labels in `game.js`.
- Added further English mappings for dashboard, news, player stats, and other dynamic labels; validation remains pending.

### Active
- Add equivalent missing Spanish translations and review English mappings for accuracy and unintended substring replacements.
- Verify Portuguese, English, and Spanish menu and career screens after a full reload, including save loading.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Inspect the English dictionary edit and add equivalent missing Spanish mappings.
2. Reload the app and check menu and career screens in all three languages; verify existing saves still load.
3. Run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`; perform the required screenshot check if needed.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Translation dictionaries, language persistence and selection, UI rendering, settings, and game logic.
- `index.html`: App entry point and default document language metadata.

## Important Context
- `game.js` and `Agents.md` have uncommitted changes.
- Browser testing used `http://localhost:3002`; dictionary changes did not appear in an already-loaded page until reload.
- The latest edit expanded the English dictionary with dynamic labels and broad lowercase terms such as `anos`, `jogos`, `clube`, and `partida`; check for accidental substring replacements.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete English and Spanish support for the football career game while preserving Portuguese behavior and existing saves.
- Finish translating dynamic UI content and verify menu and career screens in all three languages.

## Requirements
- Support `pt`, `en`, and `es`; Portuguese remains the default.
- Translate displayed UI text in English and Spanish while leaving Portuguese unchanged.
- Preserve existing saves.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Portuguese remains the default to preserve existing behavior and saves.
- Document language maps to `pt-BR`, `en`, or `es`.
- Translation replacement now checks word boundaries to avoid accidental substring replacements.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added language dictionaries, markup translation, language persistence and selection, document language updates, localized dates, and language selectors in settings.
- Prior browser checks confirmed language selection and persistence, Spanish career continuation, and match simulation.
- Added further English and Spanish translations for dynamic labels and dashboard content.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed after recent changes.

### Active
- Review remaining translation gaps and verify English and Spanish translation accuracy in dynamic content.
- Reload and check menu and career screens in Portuguese, English, and Spanish, including loading existing saves.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining untranslated text; sample translation showed some Portuguese phrases remain, e.g. English “Flamengo introduces técnico aos 45 years e 9 jogos” and Spanish “Flamengo presenta técnico aos 45 años e 9 partidos”.
2. Reload the app and check menu and career screens in all three languages; verify existing saves still load.
3. Run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`; perform the required screenshot check if needed.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Translation dictionaries, translation logic, language persistence and selection, UI rendering, settings, and game logic.
- `index.html`: App entry point and default document language metadata.

## Important Context
- `game.js` and `Agents.md` have uncommitted changes.
- Browser testing used `http://localhost:3002`; dictionary changes did not appear in an already-loaded page until reload.
- A translation sample using the latest word-boundary logic left some dynamic Portuguese wording untranslated; review both dictionary coverage and replacement behavior.

A expectativa da diretoria é uma temporada competitiva\./g,(_,experience,club)=>lang==='en'?`The new manager starts a ${tr(experience)} project at ${club}. The board expects a competitive season.`:`El nuevo entrenador inicia un proyecto de ${tr(experience)} en ${club}. La directiva espera una temporada competitiva.`);let isWordChar=ch=>ch!==undefined&&/[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(ch);return Object.entries(dict).sort((a,b)=>b[0].length-a[0].length).reduce((out,[from,to])=>{let result='',pos=0,index;while((index=out.indexOf(from,pos))!==-1){let end=index+from.length;if(!isWordChar(out[index-1])&&!isWordChar(out[end]))result+=out.slice(pos,index)+to;else result+=out.slice(pos,end);pos=end}return result+out.slice(pos)},source)}

## Objective
- Complete English and Spanish support for the football career game while preserving Portuguese behavior and existing saves.
- Finish translating dynamic UI content and verify menu and career screens in all three languages.

## Requirements
- Support `pt`, `en`, and `es`; Portuguese remains the default.
- Translate displayed UI text in English and Spanish while leaving Portuguese unchanged.
- Preserve existing saves.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Portuguese remains the default to preserve existing behavior and saves.
- Document language maps to `pt-BR`, `en`, or `es`.
- Translation replacement checks word boundaries to avoid accidental substring replacements.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added language dictionaries, markup translation, language persistence and selection, document language updates, localized dates, and language selectors in settings.
- Added more English and Spanish translations for dynamic labels and dashboard content.
- Added a targeted dynamic translation rewrite in `tr()` for manager-introduction copy in `game.js`.
- Verified that the existing `Alex Test` save loads and the career dashboard renders in English and Spanish.

### Active
- Fix remaining mixed-language generated career content; Spanish dashboard still displays “proyecto de beginner” in the saved career news.
- Verify Portuguese behavior and all three languages on menu and career screens.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Investigate why saved manager-introduction text still shows “beginner” in Spanish despite the dynamic rewrite in `tr()`.
2. Continue checking other generated news and career text for mixed-language output.
3. Verify Portuguese menu/career rendering and finish language checks; save and inspect only the latest qualifying JPEG if visual verification is needed.
4. Run `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Translation dictionaries and logic, language persistence and selection, UI rendering, news generation, and game logic.
- `index.html`: App entry point and default document language metadata.

## Important Context
- `game.js` and `Agents.md` have uncommitted changes.
- Existing save `Alex Test` loads into a Flamengo career; the dashboard was checked in English and Spanish.
- Latest Spanish dashboard showed mixed-language content: “El nuevo entrenador inicia un proyecto de beginner en Flamengo.”
- Browser URL: `http://localhost:3002`; reload after code changes to see updates.
- `git diff --check` and `node --check game.js` passed before the latest `tr()` change; rerun both.

input.prompt: Inspect game.js translation and career news generation. Find why persisted manager intro can remain mixed language after rewrite, identify other generated content language gaps. Do not edit; report exact relevant functions/lines and recommended fix. Thoroughness medium.

content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e3437f290ffewD5GM9zQu1ChcR" state="completed">
## Why the manager intro can be mixed-language

In `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`:

- **Line 32** creates the intro in Portuguese and saves it in `state.news`. It lowercases the experience value with `form.experience.toLowerCase()`, so a choice such as `Iniciante` is stored in the sentence as `iniciante`.
- **Line 21** recognizes that Portuguese sentence and rewrites it for English or Spanish, but calls `tr(experience)` with the captured lowercase value. The translation dictionaries at **lines 18–19** use capitalized keys such as `Iniciante`, `Experiente`, and `Lenda`; the lookup is case-sensitive, so the experience word remains Portuguese while the rest of the sentence is translated.
- The intro’s **title**—`${team.name} apresenta ${form.manager}` at line 32—is also created in Portuguese and has no corresponding sentence-level rewrite.
- **Lines 22 and 72–73** show why changing the language does not update the saved career: `render()` translates the displayed markup, and `setLanguage()` changes the preference and rerenders. Neither rewrites the saved intro in `state.news`. The original Portuguese text remains in the career data.

**Recommended fix:** Translate the experience from a canonical value or explicit locale map, rather than passing its lowercased display text to `tr()`. For reliable persisted content, store a structured event and render its title and body from localized templates; consider a fallback for existing saves that contain the current Portuguese sentence.

## Other generated-content gaps

Generated news and messages are also authored in Portuguese and saved as career data. The inbox displays them through the general markup translator (**lines 22 and 68**), which can translate matching dictionary entries but is not a full localization system for dynamically assembled sentences. Likely gaps include:

- **Transfers, line 67:** the generated title (“… é o novo reforço”) and body (“O clube fechou a contratação…”) have no dedicated localized templates.
- **Resignation and contract messages, lines 70 and 99:** their titles and bodies are Portuguese when created; any translation depends on individual dictionary matches.
- **Match news, line 92:** the body combines Portuguese labels and phrases with dynamic league, attendance, and revenue values.
- **Season news, line 94:** champion, season-completion, and new-season headlines and bodies are generated in Portuguese.
- **Job-change news, line 101:** both the announcement title and body are generated in Portuguese.

The same concern applies to user-facing toast messages: **line 39** runs them through `tr()`, so they can be only partially translated when their wording is not covered by the dictionary. A locale-aware message catalog with dynamic values supplied as parameters would address these gaps more consistently than expanding substring replacements.
</subagent>
